headline: Electrolux to close Jászberény appliance plant in Hungary
summary: Swedish appliance manufacturer Electrolux will shut down its production plant in Jászberény, Hungary, within weeks. The closure is expected to result in the loss of approximately 600 jobs.
why: The closure of a major manufacturing facility is a significant event for the local Hungarian economy and reflects ongoing restructuring within the European appliance sector.

impacts.name: Electrolux
impacts.why: Plant closures are often part of cost-cutting measures intended to improve long-term margins.
